title: Alone Together Closing Reception with Duo Laroo/Byrd
description: The closing celebration of the group exhibition Alone Together, with another afternoon of music, art and good company. Saskia Laroo (trumpet, saxophone, bass, vocals) and Warren Byrd (keys, vocals, bongos) play live jazz, funk and soul. A last chance to see the work of Angiola Churchill, Sydney Cash, Julie Lindell, Jan Mulder, Bix Lye and Paulien Lethen. Presented by Paulien Lethen. Suggested donation $10.
